title: PE Hospital Sale-Leaseback REIT Stripping and Friendly-PC CPOM Extraction — Locked Telemetry
description: Machine-readable lock of the 13 telemetry constants for SPEC-PE-HOSPITAL-SALE-LEASEBACK-STRIPPING-AND-CPOM-EXTRACTION-v1.0. Record base: In re Steward Health Care System LLC (Bankr. S.D. Tex. Case No. 24-90213), U.S. Senate HELP Committee Investigation (2024), Kannan et al. JAMA 2023;330(24):2365-2375, 11 U.S.C. 548, 31 U.S.C. 3729, state CPOM doctrines. Executable verification: proofs/pe_hospital_sale_leaseback_cpom_proof.py (exit code 0).

pe_sponsor_initial_equity_usd_millions.description: E_0: Sponsor initial equity deployed to acquire the hospital system (USD millions).

sale_leaseback_reit_proceeds_usd_million.description: P_SLB: Sale-leaseback proceeds from the healthcare REIT for land and acute-care buildings (USD millions).

pe_total_extracted_distributions_usd_mil.description: D_extracted: Total sponsor distributions via dividend recapitalizations and exit proceeds (USD millions).

pe_sponsor_cash_on_cash_multiple.description: M_CoC = round(800.0 / 246.0, 6). Sponsor cash-on-cash multiple locked pre-collapse (E-1).

pre_strip_hospital_ebitdar_usd_millions.description: EBITDAR: Pre-strip hospital operating earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization and rent (USD millions).

pre_strip_debt_service_usd_millions.description: DS_0: Baseline pre-strip annual debt service (USD millions).

post_strip_annual_reit_rent_escalation_u.description: R_REIT: Annual master-lease rent to the REIT, escalating (USD millions per year).

post_strip_fixed_charges_usd_millions.description: FC_post = DS_0 + R_REIT = 60.0 + 145.0. Total post-strip annual fixed charges (USD millions per year, E-3).

post_strip_fixed_charge_coverage_ratio.description: FCCR_post = round(180.0 / 205.0, 6) < 1.0. Post-strip coverage: the insolvency identity (E-4).

jama_hospital_acquired_condition_increas.description: Delta_HAC: 25.4% increase in hospital-acquired conditions post-PE acquisition (Kannan et al., JAMA 2023;330(24):2365-2375).

jama_central_line_infection_increase_rat.description: Delta_CLABSI: 37.9% increase in central-line bloodstream infections post-PE acquisition (Kannan et al., JAMA 2023;330(24):2365-2375).

section_548_fraudulent_transfer_clawback.description: C_548 = D_extracted * 1[FCCR_post < 1.0]. Constructive fraudulent transfer clawback quantum under 11 U.S.C. 548 (USD millions, E-9).
